title: Add ability to do two-finger trackpad swipe left/right between Applications and Places tabs
line: Swiping sideways with two fingers (or scrolling a horizontal mouse wheel) over Kickoff now switches between Applications and Places.
explanation: Kickoff only reacted to vertical scrolling: the footer tab bar switched tabs on vertical wheel, and the lists and grids swallow every wheel event over the content, so a sideways swipe did nothing even though the tabs slide in horizontally. The change adds a horizontal-only, non-blocking WheelHandler on top of the Applications/Places page that switches tab after one wheel notch worth of horizontal scrolling (mirrored in right-to-left), resets on vertical-dominant events and at the end of a gesture so stray sideways jitter doesn't build up, and lets vertical scrolling pass through to the views underneath.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: switch tabs with horizontal scrolling

Scrolling sideways over Kickoff's content did nothing, even though the
tabs slide horizontally. Now a two-finger horizontal swipe on a touchpad
or a horizontal mouse wheel switches between the two tabs.

BUG: 504886

media.caption: Master: horizontal scrolling right, left and over the sidebar does nothing
Fix: scrolling right opens Places, scrolling left goes back to Applications; vertical scrolling still scrolls the lists
Master: still on Applications after scrolling right over the content
Fix: one horizontal scroll notch switches to Places
